Check whether a character entered by the user is a vowel or a consonant.

Supplied answer
ch = input("Enter a single letter: ").lower()
if not ch.isalpha() or len(ch) != 1:
    print("Not a valid letter")
elif ch in "aeiou":
    print("Vowel")
else:
    print("Consonant")
Note: The in operator works on strings, so ch in "aeiou" replaces 5 comparisons.
